title: Expanding Flow Shop Tasks Based on Recursive Functions
summary: The paper discusses several extensions of the recursive representation of the flow shop scheduling problem. It is shown that recursive functions make it possible to describe multiple extensions in a single problem. The paper considers altogether six extensions. The examples consider three types of recursive functions: functions associated with the machine, functions that adjust the procession time based on constraints, and functions that control the feasibility of the schedule.
